executive_summary: This collection window (December 15-21, 2026) is the twenty-sixth archived window overall. Fresh search again re-checked both carried-forward CFDA institutional questions and found no resolution to either. The CFDA/Vogue Fashion Fund 2026 winner remains unconfirmed by any dated, sourced coverage from CFDA, Vogue, WWD, Business of Fashion, or Fashionista -- this is now the ninth consecutive window this signal has been carried forward open, roughly nine weeks after the October 20 gala; is_prolonged_silence('cfda-fashion-fund-winner', all_reports) continues to return True. The CFDA Fashion Awards question was also re-checked, again finding no confirmed 2026 date, nominee list, or post-event coverage distinct from the Fashion Fund; this is now the fourth tracked window for this signal_id, which formally crosses this archive's own four-window prolonged-silence threshold for the first time -- is_prolonged_silence('cfda-fashion-awards-2026', all_reports) now returns True. This is an observation about the pattern of the question staying open, not new evidence about cause; no cancellation, delay, or outcome is implied. Separately, this window's search confirmed that nominations for the 84th Golden Globe Awards are scheduled to be announced December 18, 2026 -- a date that falls inside this window -- but a nominations announcement is not itself style, garment, or red-carpet discourse (the ceremony and its associated red-carpet coverage do not occur until January 2027), so it is named here only for calendar precision and excluded as in-window content, consistent with this archive's discipline around distinguishing announcement dates from actual coverage. Searches for a genuine December 'year in fashion' retrospective or dated best-dressed coverage tied to an actual in-window event turned up only evergreen or future-dated material (a January 2026 Critics' Choice best-dressed piece, May 2026 Met Gala recaps, generic 2026 trend-prediction pieces) -- none of it dated to or describing this window, so none of it was logged as in-window content. No fashion week or resort/cruise runway content originates in this window per docs/EDITORIAL_CALENDAR.md. On balance this window is thin: two unresolved carried-forward institutional questions (one of which just crossed the archive's own prolonged-silence threshold), one precisely-scoped non-signal (a real but non-style announcement date named only to prevent confusion), and no verified in-window style discourse.
